execute.description: Agregar la nave sin modificar las existentes ni duplicarla
execute.sql: INSERT INTO "public"."nave" ("nombreNave") VALUES ('C - Polivalente') ON CONFLICT ("nombreNave") DO NOTHING;

postcheck.description: Verificar que existe la nave C - Polivalente
postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."nave" WHERE "nombreNave" = 'C - Polivalente') AS result;
